description:
This is a thin .NET 10 command line app/dotnet tool wrapper around the an IKVM compiled Saxon HE 12.10, allowing the use of XSLT 3.0 from the command line.
      The tool is an experimental use of IKVM and IKVM.Maven and the Saxon HE 12.10 Java release, but it is not in any way a supported or validated product of the company Saxonica, the creator of Saxon HE.
releaseNotes: This is the first release for .NET 10 using Saxon HE 12.10 and the latest release of IKVM 8.15.0 (using an updated Java 8/1.8 JDK 8u472-b08) for .NET 10
title: Saxon HE 12 .NET Xslt 3.0 command line tool
